convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (Candles_Smoothed) and two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) with custom smoothing methods and trading logic not replicable without the library source

derived_values.name: dLevel - breakout level in price units
derived_values.used_by: entry and exit signal comparison against SHigh/SLow buffers

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup

other_exits: Long closes when Close < Candles_Smoothed_Low - dLevel (SellPosClose=true)
Short closes when Close > Candles_Smoothed_High + dLevel (BuyPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: negative values = fixed lot size (abs value), positive values = deposit fraction/share. Default MM=-0.1 means 0.1 fixed lots

custom_logic_notes: Scans bars from SignalBar onward to find first breakout condition; entry only triggered when bar==SignalBar matches breakout. Uses CIsNewBar class for new bar detection. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with signal time tracking. Recount flag triggers recalculation if CopyBuffer fails. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime set from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for trade execution timing
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementing the Candles_Smoothed custom indicator logic from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (9 smoothing methods: JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA plus standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA). TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains position management functions with lot sizing logic (negative=fixed, positive=deposit fraction), new bar detection, and history loading - all must be ported. The breakout logic is straightforward: close breaks above smoothed high + level or below smoothed low - level. Multi-timeframe indicator access (H4 default) requires careful bar alignment in Python backtesting
